description_en: Unsubscribes from a pay-as-you-go Data Management (DMS) resource
description_zh: 调用RefundPayAsYouGoOrder接口，退订已购买的DMS按量付费商品
name: RefundPayAsYouGoOrder

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the tenant.

To view the ID of the tenant, go to the Data Management (DMS) console and move the pointer over the profile picture in the upper-right corner. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.help_zh:
租户ID。

取自系统右上角头像处悬停展示的租户ID信息，详情请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/181330.html
parameters.name: tid

parameters.help_en: The order ID of the order for the pay-as-you-go resource. You can call the ListEffectiveOrders operation to query the order ID
parameters.help_zh: 已购买按量付费商品的订单ID。可通过调用ListEffectiveOrders接口获取该参数的值
parameters.name: order_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID in the sales order
parameters.name: instance_id
